generator: tools/fx/gen_ui7.py (procedural numpy + Pillow on fxlib; house style of ui / ui2 / ui3 / ui5)

conventions.contract: (v4.2.0.1) the first-run tutorial (src/systems/Onboarding.js + src/scenes/OnboardOverlay.js). Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: ui7, loaded at boot.
conventions.text: No text is baked; the game renders every label.
conventions.anchor: The two hand frames are anchored on the fingertip (sprites[k].tip in frame px).
conventions.fallback: Without this atlas OnboardOverlay draws a Phaser Graphics stand-in (fv_finger).

ui_finger.notes: The pointing mitten (index finger up-left, teal cuff lower right). Anchor = the fingertip: setPosition(x, y) puts the tip on (x, y). Shown 112 logical px tall; flipX near the right edge.

ui_finger_press.notes: The same mitten touching the glass: finger 8 % shorter, hand turned +6 deg about the tip, tighter shadow. Same anchor.

ui_tap_ripple.notes: Tap ripple: white ring + warm inner glow. Scale 0.3 -> 1.1, alpha 0.9 -> 0 in 450 ms. Flattened (scaleY 0.5) it is the world pulse ring under a target pad.

ui_spot_hole.notes: Soft spotlight hole (128 px, drawn larger): transparent to r = 0.62, opaque white from r = 1.0. Tint #1b2638, alpha 0.30; four rectangles of the same tint fill the rest of the screen. Untrimmed, edge pixels extruded 2 px in the atlas.
